reason: Document A is easier to understand correctly: its sequence diagram shows the database-error paths, its response table covers every case, and its lockout example makes the rules concrete, while Document B reads more easily but contradicts itself in places (302 vs 303 redirects, deleting failure rows when the lock is set vs letting them age out, a COMMIT on the 429 path) and leaves the storage-failure paths for protected requests and logout out of its diagram.
